diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/dharness_adapter.py b/src/evidence_harness/dharness_adapter.py
index 91c6bd9..77501df 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/dharness_adapter.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/dharness_adapter.py
@@ -62,7 +62,12 @@ class DharnessAdapter(HarnessAdapter):
                 ),
                 contract=contract,
                 policy=CompletionPolicy(
-                    review_required=options.enable_completion_review,
+                    # Once the semantic-review quota is spent, later finish attempts are
+                    # judged on mechanical isolated-evidence alone instead of dead-ending.
+                    review_required=(
+                        options.enable_completion_review
+                        and state.completion_review_count < options.max_completion_reviews
+                    ),
                     max_check_timeout_sec=options.max_command_timeout_sec,
                 ),
                 trace=CompletionTrace(receipts=tuple(state.observations)),
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..6009656 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -817,10 +817,9 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
     ) -> None:
         budget = contract.b_req
         state.completion_findings = _stable_unique(reasons)
-        review_exhausted = (
-            self._options.enable_completion_review
-            and state.completion_review_count >= budget.max_completion_reviews
-        )
+        # Review quota exhaustion no longer ends the run: later finish attempts are
+        # verified mechanically (see DharnessAdapter.capture), so repairs stay available.
+        review_exhausted = False
         repair_count_before = state.repair_count
         repair_granted = not review_exhausted and repair_count_before < budget.max_repairs
         if repair_granted:
